name: Fluent settings（Windows 11 设置风格）
rationale:
This replaces the long form page with what a Windows user already knows: the Windows 11 Settings layout. On the left is a navigation pane on a Mica-like surface. On the right, each page is one column of grouped cards. Every row reads the same way: an icon, a label, a one-line description, and the control on the right edge. This fixes the main problem with the old UI. Around 50 controls sat in a single 2,500 px scroll, labels had no explanations, and important behaviour (the prompt cache, the 413 handling, the OBS caveat, features marked 未实现) lived only in tooltips or one paragraph. Now every setting has a visible one-line description in plain Chinese. Related settings sit together (history mode and the request-size limits are next to each other, with a live meter showing the last request), and the features that are not implemented say so in visible text rather than only in a title attribute.

Three pieces of chrome are always visible, so you can do the main tasks from any page:
(1) A profile card at the top of the nav, in the place where Windows Settings shows your account. It names the current config profile and links to 配置方案.
(2) A page header with the global actions on the right: dirty state (有未保存的更改 · 还原 · 保存, or a disabled ✓已保存), 生成一次, and 启动/暂停. 启动 is the only accent-filled button. 暂停 is a standard button, so the page never has two competing accent buttons.
(3) A small run card at the bottom of the nav. It shows the state dot and label, 第 N 轮, the next-capture countdown with a thin progress bar (or the start delay, or 正在生成…), and quick toggles for the overlay (弹幕层 show/hide, 清屏).

The overview page is the dashboard. A hero card holds the state chip, a large countdown, the cycle count, the last generated time and the interval, plus a dark "screen" stage that shows the last batch of danmaku in the real palette and text style. Below it are four stat tiles (耗时, 缓存命中 82%, 请求体 3.1/48 MB, 历史截图 6/8), an overlay group, summary rows for the current config that link to their pages, and the three most recent log rows.

The surfaces are quiet neutrals. There is one teal accent, taken from the app icon's speech bubble (#0f7b6c light / #5fd4b9 dark). The type ramp is Segoe UI Variable with Microsoft YaHei UI. Spacing is generous but efficient: rows are 64 px tall and groups are 24 px apart. The result feels native on Windows 10 and 11, and it is also close enough to macOS System Settings to feel at home there.
informationArchitecture:
WINDOW SHELL (grid: nav 256px | content; nav 224px when window ≤1040px)
- Nav pane, top to bottom:
  - Brand row: app icon 22px + 弹幕伴侣 + version.
  - Profile card: layers icon + active profile name + "当前配置 · 共 N 套" + chevron. Click goes to the 配置方案 page.
  - Nav items: 概览 (layout-dashboard; red dot when status.lastError) / label 设置 / 模型接口 (cpu) / 角色与用户 (user-round) / 提示词模板 (message-square-text) / 弹幕样式 (sliders-horizontal) / 运行节奏 (timer) / 截图与历史 (camera) / label 记录 / 生成日志 (history; right-aligned log count).
  - Bottom: Run card. Shows state dot + label (空闲/运行中/已暂停/错误) + "第 {cycles} 轮", then one line depending on state:
    - running with nextCycleAt: "下次截图 12 秒" + progress bar
    - first cycle after start: "启动延迟 · 首次截图 4 秒"
    - running without nextCycleAt: "正在生成…" + indeterminate bar
    - stopped: "上次生成 14:32:08"
    Then two subtle buttons: [👁 弹幕层] (aria-pressed = overlayVisible; label stays the same, the icon switches eye/eye-off) and [⌫ 清屏] (clearOverlay).
- Page header (sticky, not scrolled): page title (28px; 24px when narrow). On the right:
  - dirty: "有未保存的更改" (hidden ≤1040px) + [↶ 还原] (new: discard the draft) + [● 保存] (Ctrl+S)
  - clean: disabled [✓ 已保存]
  - always: divider + [✦ 生成一次] (busy label 生成中 with a spinner)
  - running: [❚❚ 暂停] standard button; stopped: [▶ 启动] accent button (busy label 处理中)
- Action errors (runAction failures): a dismissible critical InfoBar at the top of the current page's scroll area.

PAGES
1. 概览 #overview
   - status.lastError → critical InfoBar "上一轮生成失败 {lastError}". When running, it adds "循环仍在运行，下一轮会自动重试". Action: [查看日志].
   - Hero card, left side: state chip; "距离下一次截图" + big countdown + bar (states: starting / generating / stopped variants with "点击“启动”开始 · 启动后先等待 {startDelay} 秒再截第一张图"); meta line "已完成 {cycles} 轮 · 上次生成 {time} · 间隔 {min}–{max} 秒". Right side: DanmakuStage with the last batch and a caption "最近一轮 · N 条 · time".
   - 4 stat tiles:
     - 生成耗时 {providerLatencyMs} (sub: 其中预填充 {promptMs})
     - 缓存命中 {cached/prompt %} + meter (sub: cached / prompt tokens)
     - 请求体 {requestBytes} / {requestLimitBytes} + meter (sub: 413 后自动下调)
     - 历史截图 {historyImages} / {historyMaxImages} + meter
     Undefined values render as "—".
   - Group 弹幕层: rows 显示弹幕层 (switch → setOverlayVisible) and 清空当前弹幕 ([清空弹幕] → clearOverlay).
   - Group 当前配置 (link 管理配置方案): link rows 模型 / 角色 / 节奏 / 截图与历史, each summarising draft values, chevron → page.
   - Group 最近生成 (link 查看全部日志): the 3 latest log rows, each linking to Logs.
2. 模型接口 #model. Lead: "任何兼容 OpenAI 的接口…"
   - 连接:
     - 接口地址 (Base URL): text, 340px
     - API Key: password + reveal button
     - 模型: select (options "id · name · state · 视觉") + refresh icon button with a spinner; the description shows the model-list note "{n} 个模型 · {state} · 视觉", or the error in the critical colour; falls back to a text input when the list is empty
     - 测试连接: [测试连接] with a spinner; the result renders as a success/critical InfoBar row inside the card "连接成功 · {message} 接口：{endpoint}", dismissible
   - 生成参数:
     - 发送温度参数: switch
     - 温度: sub-row slider 0–2 + number; disabled when sendTemperature is off
     - 最大输出: tokens, 16–32768
     - 超时: ms
   - 视觉输入: 发送截图 (visionEnabled) switch.
3. 角色与用户 #character. Each description names the placeholder it fills.
   - 角色: 角色名, 语言, 语气, 人设 (stacked textarea)
   - 用户: 用户称呼, 用户身份
4. 提示词模板 #prompt
   - Card 可插入的变量: chip buttons for the 8 placeholders, plus the dashed {{activeApp}} chip with a 未实现 tag and the hint. A click inserts at the caret of the last-focused template.
   - Group 系统提示词: description (cache note), mono textarea of 11 rows, footer with line/character count.
   - Group 用户提示词: description "可留空；留空时只发送截图", mono textarea of 4 rows with a placeholder example.
5. 弹幕样式 #danmaku
   - Preview card: stage rendering sample lines with the draft fontSize ×0.8, opacity, shadow and palette, plus a zone band when zone≠full. Footer note + [生成一次看看].
   - 文字:
     - 字号: slider + number, px
     - 不透明度: slider + number
     - 文字阴影: switch
     - 单条最多字数: number, 字
   - 运动与位置:
     - 滚动时长: slider + number, 秒, "越大越慢"
     - 显示区域: segmented 全屏/上部/中部/下部
     - 密度: slider + number
   - 颜色: 配色 as a stacked full-width mono ListField + swatch chips (circle + hex); an invalid colour gives an error state.
   - 相关设置: link row "截图时排除弹幕层" → #capture.
6. 运行节奏 #timing
   - Flow diagram card: 启动 → 等待 {startDelay} 秒 → 截图并请求 (每轮要 N 条) → {releaseMin}–{releaseMax} 秒内陆续放出 → {intervalMin}–{intervalMax} 秒后下一轮, with a note that the interval starts after generation ends.
   - 节奏:
     - 启动延迟: 秒, 0–60
     - 截图间隔: min – max pair, 秒
     - 每轮弹幕: 条, 1–12
     - 投放窗口: min – max pair, 秒, 0–60
7. 截图与历史 #capture
   - 截图:
     - 截图最长边: px
     - 图片格式: segmented JPEG/PNG
     - JPEG 质量: sub-row slider + number; disabled for PNG
     - 截图时排除弹幕层: switch, with the Windows 10 2004+ / OBS caveat in visible text
     - 屏幕录制权限: [打开系统设置 ↗]; rendered only on macOS
   - 对话历史:
     - 历史轮数: 轮
     - 历史模式: radio list inside the row, each option with a description: 满额重置 / 分批滑动 (tag 缓存友好 · 推荐) / 逐轮滑动 (tag 每轮失去缓存)
   - 历史截图与请求大小:
     - 保留历史截图: switch
     - 历史截图上限: sub-row, 张; disabled when the toggle is off
     - 请求体上限: MB
     - Read-only sub-row 最近一次请求: meter + "3.1 MB / 48 MB · 6 张历史截图 · 缓存命中 82%" + [查看日志]
     - Info InfoBar explaining batch drop, cache and 413
     - Caution InfoBar (only when PNG and keep-history are both on) with action [改用 JPEG]
   - 隐私 (rows dimmed, both tagged 未实现 with visible description):
     - 隐私黑名单: disabled input
     - 保存截图到磁盘: disabled switch
8. 生成日志 #logs
   - Toolbar: "共 N 条记录" + 保留最近 [200] 条 (generationLogLimit, part of the draft) … [刷新] (spinner) [清空日志].
   - Table card with header 状态/完成时间/耗时/弹幕/截图/触发/备注. Each entry is a <details> row.
     - 备注 tags: compaction label (neutral), 输出被截断 (caution), short error (critical), history recovery.
     - Expanded detail, in order:
       - 生成的弹幕 chips, each with a palette dot
       - Three key-value columns:
         - 请求: 模型, 请求体 x / limit, 缓存 / 输入 (%), 输出 tokens + truncation note, 预填充耗时, 开始时间
         - 历史: 历史轮数, 历史模式 (mapped to its Chinese label), 历史截图 保留·本次 N 张 / 不保留, 历史压缩, 投放窗口
         - 截图: 来源, 格式 JPEG·q82, 图片大小, 传输大小 + （已缩小以适应上限）
       - log.error and screen.error as critical InfoBars
       - 原始输出 disclosure with a mono pre
   - Footer: [显示更早的 N 条].
9. 配置方案 #profiles (from the nav profile card or 管理配置方案)
   - 当前配置:
     - 配置名称: input + [重命名], disabled until changed
     - 复制为新配置: input with placeholder + [复制新建]
     - 删除此配置: danger button, disabled when only 1 profile; confirm dialog
   - 全部配置: one row per profile with an initial avatar, name, "更新于 {updatedAt}" (model name if available), and "✓ 使用中" or [切换到此配置]. The lead text says switching or copying saves first.
tokens:
FONTS
- --font: "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,sans-serif
- --font-display: same stack, starting with "Segoe UI Variable Display"
- --font-mono: "Cascadia Mono","Cascadia Code",Consolas,"SF Mono",Menlo,"Microsoft YaHei UI","Noto Sans Mono CJK SC",monospace

TYPE RAMP (px size/line-height, weight)
- caption 12/16 400: descriptions, meta, tile labels
- body 14/20 400: labels, controls
- body-strong 14/20 600: group titles, state labels, buttons in accent
- tile value 24/32 600 display, tabular-nums
- hero countdown 44/52 600 display, tabular-nums
- page title 28/36 600 display (24 when ≤1040px)
- code chips 12/16 mono; templates 13/20 mono; raw output 12/18 mono

COLOUR — LIGHT (default) / DARK (@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark))
- --mica: #f3f3f3 / #202020
- --mica-grad: linear-gradient(150deg,#edf1f5,#f3f3f3 42%,#f5f2f1) / linear-gradient(150deg,#1b1f22,#202020 42%,#231f21)
- --nav-hover: rgba(0,0,0,.04) / rgba(255,255,255,.06)
- --nav-active: rgba(0,0,0,.06) / rgba(255,255,255,.09)
- --card: #fbfbfb / #2b2b2b
- --card-2 (log detail): #f6f6f6 / #272727
- --card-hover: #f5f5f5 / #313131
- --stroke: #e5e5e5 / #353535
- --stroke-strong: #d1d1d1 / #474747
- --divider: #ebebeb / #222222
- --ctl: #ffffff / #353535
- --ctl-hover: #f9f9f9 / #3b3b3b
- --ctl-press: #f2f2f2 / #303030
- --ctl-stroke: #dedede / #424242
- --ctl-stroke-bottom (inputs): #8a8a8a / #9a9a9a
- --ctl-disabled: #f5f5f5 / #2f2f2f
- --subtle-hover: rgba(0,0,0,.05) / rgba(255,255,255,.06)
- --track: #d9d9d9 / #4a4a4a
- --text: #1b1b1b / #ffffff (16.6:1 on card)
- --text-2: #5c5c5c / #c8c8c8 (6.5:1 / 8.5:1)
- --text-3 (placeholders): #6b6b6b / #a3a3a3 (5.2:1 / 5.6:1)
- --text-dis: #a0a0a0 / #7a7a7a (disabled only)
- --accent: #0f7b6c / #5fd4b9
- --accent-hover: #0d6e61 / #55c4aa
- --accent-press: #0b5f54 / #4cb39c
- --on-accent: #ffffff / #062a23 (5.2:1 / 8.5:1)
- --accent-text: #0c6b5e / #6fe0c6 (6.2:1 / 8.9:1)
- --accent-subtle: #e2f2ee / #24403a
- --success: #0f7b0f / #6ccb5f; bg #dff6dd / #393d1b
- --caution: #9d5d00 / #fce100; caution-text #7a4a00 / #fce100; bg #fff4ce / #433519
- --critical: #c42b1c / #ff99a4; bg #fde7e9 / #442726
- --info-bg: #f2f4f7 / #303236
- --chip-bg: #f0f0f0 / #353535
- --code-bg: #f3f3f3 / #222222
- --thumb-ring: #ffffff / #454545
- --focus: #1b1b1b / #ffffff
- Danmaku stage (theme-independent): radial #ff805c @55% + radial #5680ff @50% over linear #121c33 → #1b2544 → #281f3b, with two dark silhouette layers (#1a1830/#110f20, #0c0b17); caption chip rgba(10,12,24,.62) + blur(8px), text #f3f3f3.

RADII
- --r-ctl 4px (buttons, inputs, seg, tags)
- --r-card 8px (cards, InfoBars, nav run/profile cards)
- 6px radio hover rows and code blocks
- 12px chips / state pill; 50% for dots, avatars, flow icons

SPACING SCALE
- 2 · 4 · 6 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 px
- Row: min-height 64, padding 11/16, gap 16, icon column 20 (body indent 36)
- Sub-row: min-height 56, left padding 52
- Group gap 24; group title → card 8; cards stacked 4; tiles gap 8
- Content padding: left 28, right 32 (24 when narrow) + 12 for the scrollbar; content max-width 1000
- Header min-height 76, padding 18/44/14/28
- Nav padding 10/8/12/12; nav item 36 tall, 14 gap; selection pill 3×16 accent

SHADOWS
- --shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04) / rgba(0,0,0,.2)
- --shadow-raised (slider thumb, segmented): 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1) / rgba(0,0,0,.4)
- Accent button inner bottom: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)

LAYOUT CONSTANTS
- --nav-w: 256px (224 ≤1040px)
- Control widths: w-xl 340 (280 narrow), w-lg 260 (220), w-md 180, w-num 104, w-num-s 84, slider 160 (120)
- Hero grid: 1fr | minmax(280px, 46%) (minmax(240px, 44%) narrow)
- Log grid: 72 118 56 52 84 36 1fr 16 (narrow 64 120 48 46 72 32 1fr 16)
components:
SHELL
- NavRail: brand, ProfileCard, list of NavItem, RunStatusCard.
  - NavItem: rest / hover (--nav-hover) / selected (--nav-active + 3×16 accent pill, aria-current="page") / focus-visible (2px --focus outline, 2px offset). Optional trailing count or red alert dot.
- ProfileCard (link): card surface with hover --card-hover; avatar circle in accent-subtle; chevron.
- RunStatusCard (aria-label 运行状态):
  - Head row with state dot (running = success dot with success-bg halo, paused = caution, error = critical, idle = grey) + role="status" text. Do NOT put the per-second countdown in a live region.
  - Countdown line + 4px meter, an indeterminate meter while generating, or "上次生成" when stopped.
  - Toggle button 弹幕层 (aria-pressed; pressed = accent-subtle bg + accent text) and 清屏.
- PageHeader: h1 + actions. Save button variants: dirty (standard + 6px accent dot), clean (subtle, disabled, check icon). Start = accent; Pause = standard; busy = disabled + LoaderCircle spin + 生成中/处理中.

LAYOUT PRIMITIVES
- SettingsGroup: optional h2 title (14/600) + optional right link (12px accent text, 32px hit area) + card.
- SettingRow: icon? + label (<label htmlFor> or id for aria-labelledby) + description (aria-describedby) + control slot.
  - Variants: `stack` (body slot full width under the text, indented 36px), `link` (whole row is <a>/<button>, hover --card-hover, chevron), `disabled` (label/icon --text-dis, control disabled, description stays readable).
- SubRow: indented dependent setting (温度, JPEG 质量, 历史截图上限). Disabled when its parent toggle or format turns it off.
- InfoBarRow: an InfoBar inside a card (left padding 52). Consecutive InfoBar rows share no divider.

CONTROLS
- Button
  - standard: ctl bg, ctl-stroke border with a darker bottom; hover ctl-hover; active ctl-press + text-2
  - accent
  - subtle (transparent; hover subtle-hover)
  - danger (critical text)
  - icon (32×32)
  - toggle (aria-pressed)
  - disabled: text-dis, ctl-disabled
  - all: min-height 32, focus-visible 2px ring
- TextField (`.field` wrapper):
  - 32px tall; 1px border with --ctl-stroke-bottom bottom edge
  - hover ctl-hover; focus-within = accent bottom 2px (border + inset shadow); disabled = ctl-disabled + text-dis
  - Optional unit suffix (12px text-2) and inner icon button (reveal password: eye/eye-off, aria-label 显示/隐藏 API Key)
  - Error state: critical bottom border + description switches to critical text with circle-alert
- NumberField: existing behaviour (keeps raw text while typing; commits clamped numbers via parseNumberInput; Enter or blur resets) plus a unit suffix. Use inputMode="decimal"/"numeric" and hide spinners.
- RangeNumber: two NumberFields joined by "–" inside role=group aria-labelledby the row label; each input has its own aria-label (最短间隔（秒）…).
- SliderNumber: input[type=range] (track 4px, accent fill via the --p custom property, thumb 20px with a 5px ring) bound to the same value as a NumberField. Both share the range and step from LIMITS. Disabled = grey track and thumb.
- Switch: <input type=checkbox role=switch> visually hidden over a 40×20 track, with "开/关" text on the left; the whole label is a ≥32px hit target.
  - off: 1px text-2 border, 12px text-2 knob
  - on: accent fill + on-accent knob
  - hover: knob grows to 14px
  - focus-visible: ring around the track
  - disabled: text-dis
- Select: native <select> with appearance:none inside `.field.select` and an inline SVG chevron (no CSS data-URI icon).
- Segmented: role=radiogroup of real radio inputs; 34px tall; options ≥56px wide; checked = accent-subtle bg, accent text 600, 2px accent bottom indicator; focus-visible inset ring.
- RadioList: rows of radio + title + 12px description; hover subtle-hover; checked dot = accent fill with an on-accent 8px centre; inline tags allowed.
- Tag: 20px chip. Variants: neutral (chip-bg), todo/caution (未实现, 输出被截断), ok, err, accent (推荐), mac.
- InfoBar: icon + optional bold title + message + optional actions/close.
  - Severities: info (info-bg, accent icon), success, caution, critical (tinted bg + 22% stroke).
  - role: alert for lastError and actionError, status for the connection result, note for explanations.
- Meter: 4px (6px large) track/fill. role=meter with aria-valuenow where it represents a quantity. Indeterminate animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

DATA DISPLAY
- StatTile: label with icon, value (24px) + small unit, optional meter, 12px sub line (ellipsis, full text in title). Undefined values show "—".
- Hero: state chip (running / idle / paused / error colours) + countdown + meta + DanmakuStage.
- DanmakuStage: dark scene + absolutely positioned lines using the overlay's text styles (shared CSS class). Inside the page it is decoration (role=img with an aria-label listing the comments). Optional zone band (dashed top/bottom lines) when zone≠full. Lines are placed so they never clip.
- FlowSteps (timing): 5 steps; accent-subtle circle icons joined by 2px stroke-strong lines; the loop step is grey.
- Placeholder chips: mono buttons, 32px. The todo chip has a dashed border + 未实现 tag + title hint.
- Swatch chips: 20px colour circle with an inset hairline (so #f8fafc shows on light) + hex in mono.
- LogTable: header row + <details> entries.
  - summary = the grid row (hover/open = card-hover; chevron rotates 90° when open; focus-visible inset ring)
  - detail = card-2 panel; comment chips with a colour dot; three <dl> columns (pairs stack vertically ≤1040px); InfoBars for errors; RawOutput <details> (accent summary, mono pre max 160px scroll)
  - "显示更早的 N 条" subtle button
- ProfileList rows: initial avatar (accent-subtle when active), name, updated meta, "✓ 使用中" or a switch button.

STATES TO DESIGN / IMPLEMENT
- Runtime states: idle / running (with countdown) / running + starting (start delay) / running + generating (no nextCycleAt) / paused / error (manual run failed while idle) / running + lastError.
- Mockup variants: mockup.html?state=idle|running|starting|generating|paused|error&lasterror=1#page, dirty override ?dirty=0|1, PNG warning ?png=1#capture, expand a log with ?expand=log-failed, full-length screenshots with ?full=1.
overlayStyleIdeas:
1. Offer an outline style (描边), bilibili style, alongside the soft shadow. Replace the boolean `shadow` with a 3-way 文字效果 segmented control: 描边 / 阴影 / 无. Migrate the old value as shadow:true → 阴影.
   - Outline: `-webkit-text-stroke: calc(var(--danmaku-font-size) * 0.09) rgba(0,0,0,.6); paint-order: stroke fill;`
   - Shadow: keep the current `0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.26)`.
   An outline keeps light colours (#f8fafc, #f59e0b) readable on white web pages, where a blurred shadow washes out.
2. Adapt the outline to each colour. For dark palette entries (luminance < 0.25, e.g. #5b8def on dark scenes) use a light halo (`rgba(255,255,255,.55)`) instead of a black stroke. Compute it once when parsing the palette and pass it as `--stroke-color` per line.
3. Keep weight 800 with the system stack, adding "Segoe UI Emoji" and "Segoe UI Symbol" before sans-serif so the model's emoji render in colour. Add letter-spacing 0.02em for CJK at sizes ≥ 28px.
4. Fade in at the right edge: an extra keyframe on opacity 0→var(--danmaku-opacity) over the first 4% of the animation, and fade out over the last 3%. This hides the hard pop when a line is planned with a delay.
5. Performance: `will-change: transform; contain: layout paint style;` on lines, `translate3d` in the keyframes. Avoid layout-triggering properties. Cap concurrent lines (MAX_ITEMS 80) as now.
6. Reduced motion: under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, do not scroll. Show each comment fixed in its lane, centred or right-aligned, for speedSeconds × 0.6, with a 200 ms fade in and out.
7. Zone: draw nothing on the overlay itself (it is click-through and must stay invisible). The settings preview stage shows the zone band so users understand 上部/中部/下部.
8. Faithful preview: the settings DanmakuStage reuses the exact overlay class (`.danmaku-line` + `.with-shadow`/outline) with font-size × 0.8 rather than a CSS transform, so text rendering matches the real overlay.
9. Optional later: a "高级" fixed top/bottom style (bilibili 顶部/底部弹幕) for the first comment of each batch, as a separate toggle. Off by default to keep the current behaviour.

LAYOUT

COUNTDOWN AND STATE
- Write a `useCountdown(nextCycleAt)` hook inside a small `<Countdown>` component, so only that component re-renders on a 250–500 ms interval, not SettingsApp.
- Progress needs the total duration. Store `armedAt = Date.now()` in a ref whenever nextCycleAt changes value; progress = (now − armedAt) / (due − armedAt).
- Better: add to RuntimeStatus `nextCycleArmedAt?: string` and `nextCycleIsFirst?: boolean`. The controller already knows `cycleTimer.firstAfterStart` and `dueAt`. That gives an exact bar and the "启动延迟" label. Without it, label the first countdown after start() as 启动延迟 on the client side.
- Display tokens:
  - running && nextCycleAt → countdown
  - running && !nextCycleAt → "正在生成…" + indeterminate bar
  - paused / idle / error → "上次生成"
- `state === 'error'` only happens when a manual run fails while stopped. While running, failures keep state 'running' with lastError set, so show the lastError InfoBar based on `status.lastError`, not on state.
- Do not announce the countdown each second. The status text has role="status" and changes only when the state changes.

MOCKUP PITFALLS NOT TO COPY

weaknesses:
- Settings are spread over 8 pages plus a profiles page. Tuning across areas (model + prompt + history at once) means hopping between pages. There is no search box, which Windows Settings users expect, and adding one means indexing row labels and keywords.
- It is less dense than the old grid. The capture page is about 1,450 px tall, so the history/request-size section is below the fold at 760 px. Rows of 64 px trade density for scanability.
- Some controls appear twice: overlay show/hide and clear are in both the nav run card and the overview page, and 生成一次 is in the header and on the danmaku preview. That could feel redundant. The header is crowded at 940 px when dirty and running (还原, 保存, 生成一次, 暂停), so labels must stay short. Any longer copy or busy text needs testing.
- An accurate countdown progress bar and the 启动延迟 label need a small RuntimeStatus addition (nextCycleArmedAt / nextCycleIsFirst). Without it, the client has to guess from when nextCycleAt first appeared.
- The overview stage needs the last batch with its real colours. That means subscribing the settings window to onDanmakuItems, or approximating colours from the palette, because log entries do not store per-comment colours.
- The Mica look is faked with a gradient, and the brand teal is not the user's Windows accent. Purists may find it "almost native", and following the system accent risks clashing with the danmaku palette and needs contrast handling.
- The log table relies on fixed column widths. At the 940 px minimum the time and size columns are tight, and long error notes truncate to ellipsis with the full text only in the expanded detail and title.
- The custom-styled slider, switch and segmented controls need explicit forced-colors (high contrast) rules and Windows testing. The mockup was verified for light/dark contrast and focus rings, but not in Windows high-contrast themes.
- The hand-built segmented control and radio list add more custom CSS than plain form fields. Done naively, keyboard behaviour (arrow keys in radio groups) can regress, so use real radio inputs as the mockup does.
